notes.title: Galaxy Combat Wargames Hits The Gold Version YOHOO!
notes.notes:
We are extremely delighted to announce that our upcoming Head To Head   Space Shooter Galaxy Combat Wargames has hit the Gold Version. 

Galaxy Combat Wargames is on its way to release on 29th September, 2016. Read the full [url=http://gamespress.com/release.asp?c=83caf8--141439] Press Release[/url] to know about Gold Version Announcement and tell us what you think? :) 

Till then we should tease you with this screenshot ;)


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26257638/8c4b09d53d72a28357ed35e14ac7b65d2ba4c6ea.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Galaxy Combat Wargames Gets A Release Date!
notes.notes:
We are super excited to announce the release date of our multiplayer head to head space shooter game for the PC players. Galaxy Combat Wargames will hit steam stores on 29th September, 2016. The game will be free to play :)

Read more about the full announcement in this [url=http://gamespress.com/release.asp?i=26986996&pk=67957704] Press Release[/url]

Feel free to share your thoughts about the game. What do you expect from this space game. We shall be here attending you all the time :)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26257638/b1d08e0565800c245f4b0055003b725176a3f190.jpg[/img]
